name: Look
description: The first thing people notice about the character's build, face, and manner of dress.

name: Personality
description: The manner that shows through in conversation and under pressure.

name: Accent
description: How the character sounds, and what that suggests about where they come from.

name: Quirk
description: A small habit that makes the character easy to picture and remember.

name: Goal
description: What the character wants badly enough to risk danger for. Write one or two sentences.

name: Experience Track
description: The track every character in this campaign uses for experience and levelling.
